nations.name: Varrow
nations.epithet: the horse-lords of the iron steppe

ruler.name: Hadrik the Unbowed
ruler.title: King of Varrow, Lord of the Iron Steppe

nations.personality: Proud, blunt and quick to anger. Respects strength and plain speech; despises flattery, haggling and anyone who hides behind clever words.
nations.oneLiner: Proud and blunt. Respects strength, despises flattery.
nations.speechStyle: Speaks of himself only as 'Varrow', in the third person. Short, hard sentences full of horses, iron and winter.
nations.secretGoal: Avenge the Burning of Harrowmere: break Kelm in open war and take at least one Kelmish province.
nations.aim: Break Kelm in war and take a Kelmish province.
nations.hint: Revenge on Kelm, and land to show for it.

redLine.text: Threaten Varrow once and Varrow remembers. Threaten Varrow twice and Varrow rides.

grudges.reason: Kelmish fire-ships burned Harrowmere thirty winters ago, and Kelm has never paid the blood-price.
The Duchess of Sael laughed at Varrow's envoys and bought its horses at half their worth.

friends.reason: Ostrin's priests blessed Hadrik's crowning, and Varrish riders guard the pilgrim roads.

nations.name: Kelm
nations.epithet: the counting-house league of the river cities

ruler.name: Ysolde Marrow
ruler.title: First Chancellor of the Kelmish League

nations.personality: Cold, courteous and calculating. Believes every loyalty has a price and every debt must be paid. Patient as compound interest.
nations.oneLiner: Cold and calculating. Every loyalty has a price.
nations.speechStyle: Talks in ledgers, debts and percentages, quoting exact figures. Says 'Noted.' whenever she is displeased.
nations.secretGoal: Own the Crossing: drain the Warden's treasury until the passes and their tolls can be bought outright for Kelm.
nations.aim: Drain your treasury, then buy the Crossing outright.
nations.hint: Your gold. Possibly all of it.

redLine.text: Kelm forgives a debt before it forgives a lie. Deal falsely once, and the account is closed.

grudges.reason: Varrish riders raid Kelm's grain barges and call it old justice.
Tarnish reed-pirates prey on Kelm's river trade, and the clans refuse all compensation.

friends.reason: Kelmish banks finance Saelish fleets; the two courts share a table at every fair.

nations.name: Sael
nations.epithet: the silk-and-salt duchy of the harbours

ruler.name: Lisette Aumery
ruler.title: Duchess of Sael, Mistress of the Salt Roads

nations.personality: Charming, witty and vain, with spies in every court. Loves gifts and flattery and bores quickly; far more dangerous than she lets anyone see.
nations.oneLiner: Charming and vain, with spies in every court.
nations.speechStyle: Honeyed and teasing, full of sea and silk metaphors. Calls the player 'darling' and ends many sentences with a question.
nations.secretGoal: Let Varrow and Kelm bleed each other white, then buy their ruined provinces for a song.
nations.aim: Let Varrow and Kelm bleed, then buy their ruins cheap.

redLine.text: Open your roads to Varrow's horsemen, darling, and you will have chosen a side. It will not be mine.

grudges.reason: Varrow covets Sael's harbours and says so, loudly, at every feast.
Ostrin's priests preach against Sael's 'harbour of sins' and burn its silks.

friends.reason: Kelmish gold and Saelish ships have made each other rich for a generation.

nations.name: The Tarn
nations.epithet: the reed clans of the drowned fens

ruler.name: Mother Gethin
ruler.title: Speaker of the Tarn, Eldest of the Reed Clans

nations.personality: Taciturn, shrewd and patient as the fens. Distrusts kings, coin and fine words. Remembers every slight for a hundred years.
nations.speechStyle: Terse. Answers in fen proverbs about water, reeds and weather, often answers a question with a question, and says 'Hm.' when unimpressed.
nations.secretGoal: Take back the burial hills: seize an Ostrine province where the clans' ancestors lie, and humble the Hierarch.
nations.aim: Seize the burial hills from Ostrin and humble the Hierarch.
nations.hint: The hills Ostrin took from the clans.

redLine.text: Soldiers at the edge of the fen are soldiers in the fen. The Tarn does not wait to drown.

grudges.reason: Ostrin's priests drove the clans from the burial hills and burned the reed-shrines.
Kelmish usurers bought the clans' debts and sent bailiffs into the fens.

nations.name: Ostrin
nations.epithet: the lamplit theocracy of the high passes

ruler.name: Anselm Vey
ruler.title: Hierarch of Ostrin, Keeper of the Seven Lamps

nations.personality: Devout, soft-spoken and suspicious of outsiders. Sees omens in everything. Slow to anger, and never forgets once angered.
nations.oneLiner: Devout and suspicious. Sees omens in everything.
nations.speechStyle: Speaks in scripture and omens, often beginning 'It is written...', and calls the player 'child'.
nations.secretGoal: Reclaim the valley shrine: Ostrin holds that the heart of the Crossing is holy ground stolen from the Lamp, and means to take it back.
nations.aim: Take back the shrine at the heart of your valley.

redLine.text: Whoever takes the hand of the heretic Tarn takes up the Lamp's curse.

grudges.reason: The fen clans burned the Lamp-house at Saint Orrin's and still worship the drowned gods.
Sael shelters Ostrin's heretics and prints their pamphlets for profit.

friends.reason: The Hierarch crowned Hadrik; Varrish lances keep the pilgrim roads safe.
